blocks.text: Match preview: India U19 face Australia U19 in 3rd unofficial ODI (ODI) on Wed, 23 Sept, 2026, 9:00 am at Niranjan Shah Stadium, Khandheri Rajkot. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Standard ODI surface expected. Conditions will be clearer at the toss — monitor team selection and dew factor for night games.
Expected par score: 250–290 runs par score.
Overcast · High 33°C / Low 25°C · Rain: 0 mm · Wind: up to 10 km/h. Cloud cover expected — seamers may get movement with the new ball.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
